title: Smallest Missing Multiple of K
summary: Given an integer array and a positive integer k, find the least positive multiple of k not present in the array.
statement: Given an integer array and a positive integer k, find the least positive multiple of k not present in the array. A multiple of k is any number that can be divided by k without a remainder.
constraints: Consider positive multiples k, 2k, 3k, and so on.
Return the first such multiple absent from nums.
Array values that are not multiples of k do not affect the answer.
reference_solution:
def smallest_missing_positive_multiple(nums,k):
    seen=set(nums);value=k
    while value in seen:value+=k
    return value
known_wrong_solutions:
def smallest_missing_positive_multiple(nums,k):
    seen=set(nums);value=1
    while value in seen:value+=k
    return value
def smallest_missing_positive_multiple(nums,k):
    seen=set(nums);value=k
    while value in seen:value+=1
    return value
hints: Put all input values in a set.
Start with the first positive multiple k.
Advance by exactly k while the candidate is present.
The first absent candidate is the least missing positive multiple.
editorial: The first absent candidate is the least missing positive multiple.

tests.explanation: Two, four, six, and eight are present; ten is the first missing multiple.
Two is absent, so it is returned immediately.
